title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit Refill Timing Edit Values
content:
The refill timing values of the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit fix, for each network, the fraction of the previous fill's days supply that must have elapsed before a drug can be refilled, the maximum extra days supply a member may accumulate through early refills of one drug, and the rolling window over which those accumulated days are counted.

| | Northbridge Performance Network | Northbridge Essential Network | Northbridge National Network | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | Northbridge Retail90 Network | Northbridge Open Choice Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fraction elapsed before refill, drug not a controlled substance | 0.8 | 0.8 | 0.75 | 0.75 | 0.75 | 0.75 |
| Fraction elapsed before refill, controlled substance | 0.9 | 0.9 | 0.85 | 0.85 | 0.85 | 0.85 |
| Maximum accumulated early-refill days per drug | 7 | 7 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 |
| Accumulation window, rolling calendar days | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |

## Controlled substances (all six networks)

The DEA-scheduled controlled substances on the Northbridge Rx drug master list for these edits are: oxycodone-acetaminophen. All of them are opioids for the opioid edits.

## Thresholds worked on example fills (hypothetical)

| Hypothetical previous fill | Fraction | Days that must have elapsed |
|---|---|---|
| 30-day supply of a drug that is not controlled, Northbridge Essential Network | 0.8 (80 percent) | 24 days |
| 30-day supply of a drug that is not controlled, Northbridge National Network | 0.75 (75 percent) | 22.5 days |
| 30-day supply of a controlled substance, Northbridge Performance Network | 0.9 (90 percent) | 27 days |
| 30-day supply of a controlled substance, Northbridge Open Choice Network | 0.85 (85 percent) | 25.5 days |
